Name: Seraiah the Chief Priest
Summary: Seraiah the chief priest was taken with Zephaniah the second priest to Riblah after Jerusalem fell, where the king of Babylon slew them. He is a different man from Seraiah son of Neriah, Seraiah son of Azriel, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth.
KeyStory: Nebuzaradan took Seraiah the chief priest and Zephaniah the second priest to Riblah, and the king of Babylon smote them and put them to death.
LifeLesson: The highest religious office offers no shelter when the city it served has fallen.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
